resources.string: Keep the code window open. Tap Enter code here. This notification is available for 10 minutes.

1. Open phone setup and enable Wireless debugging.\n2. Choose Pair device with pairing code.\n3. Keep that window open. Pull down notifications and enter the code in MM Auto’s notification. You have 10 minutes to enter it.
Allow MM Auto notifications to enter the code without closing the pairing window. Then return here and open phone setup again.
Paired. Tap here to return and check the connection before installing.
Pairing did not finish. Tap here to retry with a new code. Keep the code window open.
Pairing notification expired. Tap here, then open phone setup to start again.
